title: Boundary of Anosov coaffine representations
summary: Let $Γ\le \mathrm{SL}(d+1,\mathbb R)$ be a torsion-free hyperbolic group dividing a properly and strictly convex domain $Ω\subset \mathbb R\mathrm P^d$, and let $ρ: Γ\to \mathrm{SL}(d+1,\mathbb R)$ be the inclusion. We study representations of $Γ$ into the coaffine group that are deformations of $ρ\oplus 1 \in \mathrm{Hom}(Γ, \mathrm{GL}(d+2,\mathbb R))$ and that lie on the boundary of the locus of projective Anosov representations.
